Routes are evaluated in registration order, and the first matching method/pattern wins. The route table is grouped by domain in `server.js`, but the order within each domain is preserved from previous stages so that parameterized routes (e.g., `/v1/combat/sessions/:id/conditions`) are still registered before their more general parents (`/v1/combat/sessions`).\n\nThe router preserves the following behavior, which the cumulative evaluator suite depends on:\n\n- `GET`, `DELETE`, or any method other than `POST`/`PUT` without a matching route returns `405 Method Not Allowed` and does not read the body.\n- `POST` or `PUT` without a matching route reads the body, then returns `404 Not Found`.\n- `POST` or `PUT` with a matching route reads the body and runs the handler.\n\n`POST`/`PUT` handlers receive the raw body on `req.body` as a string. Shared helpers handle repeated authorization, turn checks, and response formatting.\n- `lib/db.js` only talks to SQLite and maps rows to/from JS objects.\n- `lib/domain.js` has no side effects and no ----------\n\nfunction activeCombatant(session) {\n  const c = session.order[session.turn_index];\n  return { name: c.name, score: c.score };\n}\n\nfunction publicOrder(order) {\n  return order.map(c (!domain.isNonEmptyString(id)) {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid id');\n  }\n  if (db.getSession(id)) {\n    return badRequest(res, 'session already exists');\n  }\n\n  const combatants = names.add(c.name);\n  }\n\n  const order = domain.buildCombatOrder(combatants);\n  const session = {\n    id,\n    round: 1,\n    turn_index: 0,\n    order,\n    conditions: {},\n  };\n\n  db.createSession(session);\n  sendJson(res, 200, {\n    id,\n    round: 1,\n    turn_index: 0,\n    active: activeCombatant(session),\n    order: publicOrder(order),\n  });\n}\n\nexport function addCondition(req, res, id) {\n  const session = db.getSession(id);\n  if (!session) return notFound(res);\n\n  const body = requireBody(req);\n  if (body.error) return badRequest(res, body.error);\n\n  const target = body.value?.target;\n  const condition = body.value?.condition;\n  const durationRounds = body.value?.duration_rounds;\n\n  if (!domain.isNonEmptyString(target) || !domain.isNonEmptyString(condition) || !domain.isPositiveInteger(durationRounds)) {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid fields');\n  }\n\n  const names = new Set(session.order.map(c => c.name));\n const session = db.getSession(id);\n  if (!session) return notFound(res);\n\n  session.turn_index += 1;\n  if (session.turn_index >= session.order.length) {\n    session.turn_index = 0;\n    session.round += 1;\n  }\n\n  // Conditions attached to the newly-active combatant tick down at the start of\n  // that combatant's turn and are removed when they reach 0.\n  const activeName = session.order[session.turn_index].name;\n  if (session.conditions[activeName]) {\n    session.conditions[activeName] = session.conditions[activeName]\n      .map(c => ({ ...c, remaining_rounds: c.remaining_rounds - 1 }))\n      .filter(c => c.remaining_rounds > 0);\n  }\n\n  db.updateSession(session);\n  sendJson(res, 200, {\n    id: session.id,\n    round: session.round,\n    turn_index: session.turn_index,\n    active: activeCombatant(session),\n    conditions: publicConditions(session),\n  });\n}\n\n// ---------- compendium ----------\n\nexport function createMonster(req, res) {\n The first route with a matching method and URL\n// wins, and its captured path segments are passed to the handler as positional\n// arguments.\n//\n// Routing preserves the original behavior of the cumulative evaluator suite:\n//   - GET/DELETE or any method other than POST/PUT without a match -> 405\n//     Method Not Allowed (body is not read)\n//   - POST or PUT without a match -> body is read, then 404 Not Found\n//   - POST or PUT with a match -> body is read, then the handler runs\nexport function createRouter() {\n  const routes = [];\n\n  function add(method, pattern, handler) {\n    routes.push({ method, pattern, handler });\n    return router;\n  }\n\n  async function handle(req, res) {\n    const { method, url } = req;\n    const readsBody = method === 'POST' || method === 'PUT';\n\n    for (const route of routes) {\n      if (route.method !== method) continue;\n      const match = url.match(route.pattern);\n      if (match) {\n        if (readsBody) {\n          req.body = await readBody(req);\n        }\n        // Spread captured groups so handlers receive each path segment as a\n        // separate positional argument (e.g., id, slug, campaignId).\n        return route.handler(req, res, ...match.slice(1));\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!readsBody) {\n      return methodNotAllowed(res);\n    }\n\n    req.body = await readBody(req);\n    return notFound(res);\n  }\n\n  const router = {\n    get: (pattern, handler) => add('GET', pattern, handler),\n    post: (pattern, handler) => add('POST', pattern, handler),\n    put: (pattern, handler) => add('PUT', pattern, handler),\n    delete: (pattern, handler) => add('DELETE', pattern, handler),\n    handle,\n  };\n\n  return router;\n}\n"}],"isError":false,"timestamp":1785472092692},{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"Good.
